overview: The Clan Merchant Hall is the central indoor trade chamber for clan‑to‑clan commerce and premium goods.
history: The hall was established to formalize clan trade agreements.
Clan insignia banners were added to represent merchant lineages.
Premium vaults were constructed to store high‑value goods.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the hall was expanded with new contract alcoves.
Royal Guard began monitoring the hall for trade disputes and fraud.
hooks: A clan contract dispute escalates into a heroic event.
A merchant ledger reveals suspicious activity.
A caravan broker requests emergency clan arbitration.
